title: Dollar $ign $tussy
body: MC, singer and songwriter from Pretoria West. Known as $tussy, with the dollar sign.
His music traces personal growth, belief and the realities of finding a way forward. The artist’s public Spotify biography places vulnerability at the centre of his writing.
Listen on Spotify or follow @stussydssr on Instagram and TikTok.

title: Mfana ko West
body: Pretoria West is home. Mfana ko West began as the title of his first SoundCloud offering in 2022 and became part of his artistic identity.
He began pursuing music seriously in 2020. His Spotify biography names him as a finalist in HomeComing Events’ Artist on the Rise in 2023 and 2024.

title: IN $ WE TRUST · 2026
body: The 2026 mixtape explores faith, comparison, self-doubt and becoming.
The project brings together Stocko, Facelift, Found U, Please Say the $, Better Man, 19:00 and That’s a Fact — Bonus Track. Open Music to listen.

title: Speak Fast · out now
body: Speak Fast is available on Spotify. Released 25 September 2026.
Open Music for the Spotify player, or Links to go straight to the release.

title: From We Here to IN $ WE TRUST
body: We Here (2024) includes We Back, Next 2 U and The Lottery.
Dialed In (2024) pairs $tussy with producer Jay Dipitsa. Facelift followed in 2025, ahead of In $ We Trust and Speak Fast in 2026.

title: Management + bookings
